sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission investigated allegations about a senior police officer's disclosure of confidential information and use of police vehicles.
sentences.support: Operation Pemaquid focussed on two matters of potential misconduct: the release of confidential information; and the misuse of police motor vehicles.

sentences.text: The Commission formed opinions of police misconduct concerning the officer's vehicle use and repeated disclosure of confidential information.
sentences.support: The Commission has formed an opinion of police misconduct on two matters:

sentences.text: The Commission emphasised that its misconduct opinion did not establish guilt of a criminal or disciplinary offence.
sentences.support: An opinion that misconduct has occurred is not to be taken as a finding or opinion that a particular person is guilty

sentences.text: The Commission made two recommendations: review the vehicle commuting policy and regularly remind staff about confidentiality.
sentences.support: WA Police gives periodic reminders that stress the importance of confidentiality.

notes: INTRODUCTION summarises the investigation and misconduct opinions. Existing OPAX findings are not duplicated. Two recommendations appear in the report, on PDF pages 21 and 30.
